name: Semantic linting
summary: Flag prose that violates a stated style or policy rule, as a lint finding.

input.state: The lint rule followed by the text under review.

violates.instructions: The text violates the lint rule the state opens with.
violates.criteria: Answer yes only when the state supports it; otherwise no.

cost.bound: one judgment per rule per text; N rules is N judgments

uncertainty.abstain: text the rule does not reach answers clean - lint rules do not generalize beyond their wording
uncertainty.refusal: a refused pair reports refused and is listed as an unrun check

limits: Findings are advisory like any lint - the writer or CI policy decides enforcement.
One rule per judgment: a 'write well' mega-rule has no measurable meaning.

examples.api: POST /v1/systemone per item, or /v1/classify with items as inputs
examples.mcp: oak-mcp ask tool with the same envelope

evidence.label: unmeasured
evidence.note: Composition is verified over recorded answers by crates/gym/tests/recipes.rs; model-quality measurement runs through a gym suite and is pinned here only when it exists.
